codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured implementation that fully satisfies all 7 feature requirements. Created volatility_analyzer.py (240 lines) wrapping PsList, CmdLine, and NetScan plugins. Updated memory_forensics.py to route .dmp/.mem files through VolatilityAnalyzer instead of WMIC. SKIP_VOLATILITY env var provides CI-safe mock. MCP analyze_memory_dump tool works end-to-end through the existing handler since MemoryForensics now delegates dump analysis internally. ML anomaly scoring preserved on both dump and live paths. Tests are solid with 4 focused cases covering dump routing, mock fallback, MCP integration, and missing-file rejection.

issues.description: Uses deprecated `dt.datetime.utcnow()` (deprecated since Python 3.12, PEP 670). Should use `dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)` for consistency with memory_forensics.py which already uses the timezone-aware variant. Same issue on line 221.

`str | None` union syntax in _progress_callback type hint requires Python 3.10+ at runtime. Mitigated by `from __future__ import annotations` at top of file, so annotations are evaluated as strings. Works correctly on 3.9+ but could confuse static analysis tools targeting 3.9.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` in the new volatility_analyzer.py while the existing memory_forensics.py (also modified in this commit) correctly uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. AGENTS.md doesn't document a preference for timezone-aware datetime construction, which could prevent future inconsistencies.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/reveng/malware/volatility_analyzer.py lines 91 and 221 use `dt.datetime.utcnow()`, while src/reveng/malware/memory_forensics.py line 209 uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` — inconsistent within the same commit.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly documented Volatility3 integration details in .factory/library/ai-forensics.md including the SKIP_VOLATILITY env var, validation commands, and architecture notes. This is thorough and actionable for future workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/ai-forensics.md appended with 'Volatility3 memory forensics notes' section covering analyzer location, dump routing, CI mock, and requirements.txt pin.
